title: Bosnia-Herzegovina coach grabs ball, gets yellow card as he flips out in World Cup loss to USMNT
text:
The Bosnian manager was irate and grabbed the ball after the refs didn’t blow the whistle following a physical play in their loss to the United States.
The Bosnian manager was irate and grabbed the ball after the refs didn’t blow the whistle following a physical play between Esmir Bajraktarević and Antonee Robinson.
The two opposing players were trying to make a play on the ball when Bajraktarević and Robinson collided into each other, sending the Bosnian player to the ground. The ball ended up going out of bounds moments later, and an irate Barbarez picked up the ball before starting to scream in the direction of the official.
He continued to yell and at one point, seemed to refuse to give the ball to Malik Tillman along the sideline and continued to yell at the official. Brazilian referee Raphael Claus went up to Barbarez, who eventually dropped the ball. After a back-and-forth, Barbarez was assessed a yellow card.
Sergej Barbarez, head coach of Bosnia and Herzegovina, argues with referee Raphael Claus during his team’s 2-0 loss to the United States in a World Cup Round of 32 match on July 1, 2026 in Santa Clara, Calif.in the 64th minute after he stepped on the back of the foot and ankle of Bosnia’s Tarik Muharemović. It ended Bosnia’s run in the World Cup, which was the country’s second appearance at the tournament.
